answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before trading, sized to the value it moves. A sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so running a hundred copies costs a hundred deposits. The deposit only returns after a clean record of completed work. The shared pool works like a dune: each grain is one small stake, and together they form a ledge that cheap copies cannot climb. Verified agents earn a lotus mark in the registry, which buyers can check before they pay.
